scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../crates/spektrafilm-web --target web --out-dir ../../web/public/wasm --release && npm run typecheck:bindings && npm run build:wasm:threaded && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:wasm:threaded: RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory' rustup run nightly-2025-06-01 wasm-pack build ../crates/spektrafilm-web --target web --out-dir ../../web/public/wasm-threaded --release --features threads -Z build-std=panic_abort,std
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:coverage:browser && npm run test:coverage:rust && npm run test:iphone-safari
scripts.release:verify: npm run test:all && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run typecheck && vite --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.test:coverage:browser: E2E_COVERAGE=1 playwright test --config playwright.coverage.config.ts && node scripts/report-browser-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:coverage:rust: cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p spektrafilm-web --lcov --output-path coverage/rust.lcov && node scripts/check-lcov.mjs coverage/rust.lcov
